actions.description: Answer questions about the IDURAR ERP CRM app itself from its own pages and docs: what the product is, its modules (dashboard, customers, invoices, payments, settings), how invoicing and payment recording work, how to sign in, licensing/pricing. Read-only; returns the most relevant content sections with their source pages so you can compose an answer. Create a real invoice for an existing client in this workspace. Give the client name (as stored in Customers) or client id, plus line items with quantity and unit price; the server computes totals and the next invoice number is assigned automatically. This saves a new invoice record and navigates the page to it so the user sees the result. Returns the created invoice id, number, totals and payment status. client.description: Client name exactly as stored in Customers, or a client id.

status.description: Workflow status. Default: draft.

expired_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days after the invoice date.

actions.description: Search this workspace's customer records by name or email (case-insensitive substring). Read-only. Returns up to 20 matching clients with id, name, email, phone and country — use the id or exact name with create_invoice, list_invoices or record_payment.

query.description: Part of the client name or email.

actions.description: List this workspace's invoices, optionally filtered by payment status (by payment state), workflow status (draft, pending, sent, refunded, cancelled, on hold) and/or client name. Read-only; searches the most recent ~100 invoices. Returns per invoice: number, client, dates, total, amount paid, outstanding balance, statuses, id, and its line items (name, quantity, price). Use it to look up invoices and their line items.

payment_status.description: Only invoices with this payment status.

status.description: Only invoices with this workflow status.

client.description: Only invoices for this client (name or id).

actions.description: Record a payment received against an existing invoice, by invoice number or id. This writes a real payment record and updates the invoice's paid amount and payment status (unpaid → partially → paid); an amount above the outstanding balance is rejected. Navigates the page to the updated invoice so the user sees the new status. Returns the payment id plus the invoice's updated balance and payment status.

invoice.description: Invoice id, number (e.g. "42"), or number/year (e.g. "42/2026"). If a bare number matches more than one invoice, the call is rejected — pass number/year or the id.

ref.description: Payment reference, e.g. a wire or check number.

actions.description: Read-only snapshot of this workspace's finances for a period (week, month or year; default month): total invoiced, amount still due, invoice status breakdown, payments received, and client activity — the same numbers as the dashboard. Use it for finance questions.

ref.description: Payment reference, e.g. a wire or check number.

actions.description: Answer questions about the IDURAR ERP CRM app itself from its own pages and docs: what the product is, its modules (dashboard, customers, invoices, payments, settings), how invoicing and payment recording work, how to sign in, licensing/pricing. Read-only; returns the most relevant content sections with their source pages so you can compose an answer. It does NOT read business records — after signing in, use find_clients / list_invoices for that.

Create a real invoice for an existing client in this workspace. Give the client name (as stored in Customers) or client id, plus line items with quantity and unit price; the server computes totals and the next invoice number is assigned automatically. This saves a new invoice record and navigates the page to it so the user sees the result. Returns the created invoice id, number, totals and payment status. Use find_clients first if unsure of the exact client name.

client.description: Client name exactly as stored in Customers, or a client id.

status.description: Workflow status. Default: draft.

expired_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days after the invoice date.

actions.description: Search this workspace's customer records by name or email (case-insensitive substring). Read-only. Returns up to 20 matching clients with id, name, email, phone and country — use the id or exact name with create_invoice, list_invoices or record_payment.

query.description: Part of the client name or email.

actions.description: List this workspace's invoices, optionally filtered by payment status (by payment state), workflow status (draft, pending, sent, refunded, cancelled, on hold) and/or client name. Read-only; searches the most recent ~100 invoices. Returns per invoice: number, client, dates, total, amount paid, outstanding balance, statuses, id, and its line items (name, quantity, price). Use it to look up invoices and their line items.

payment_status.description: Only invoices with this payment status.

status.description: Only invoices with this workflow status.

client.description: Only invoices for this client (name or id).

actions.description: Record a payment received against an existing invoice, by invoice number or id. This writes a real payment record and updates the invoice's paid amount and payment status (unpaid → partially → paid); an amount above the outstanding balance is rejected. Navigates the page to the updated invoice so the user sees the new status. Returns the payment id plus the invoice's updated balance and payment status.

invoice.description: Invoice id, number (e.g. "42"), or number/year (e.g. "42/2026"). If a bare number matches more than one invoice, the call is rejected — pass number/year or the id.

ref.description: Payment reference, e.g. a wire or check number.

actions.description: Read-only snapshot of this workspace's finances for a period (week, month or year; default month): total invoiced, amount still due, invoice status breakdown, payments received, and client activity — the same numbers as the dashboard. Use it for finance questions.
